note: _non fuimus subjectibilis illi_ – we were not submissive/obedient to him; wir waren ihm nicht unterwürfig (= _subjecti_); _eramus incredibilis ad dominum deum nostrum_ – we were in disbelief to the Lord our God; wir waren ungläubig (= _non credens_) (…). The ending -_bilis_ here indicates not only the possibility, but the actuality. – Friedrich Stummer: _Einführung in die lateinische Bibel_. Paderborn 1928 (viii, 290 pp.), p. 59.
